title: Optimal Projection-Free Adaptive SGD for Matrix Optimization
summary: Recently, Jiang et al. [2026] developed Leon, a practical variant of One-sided Shampoo [Xie et al., 2025a, An et al., 2025] algorithm for online convex optimization, which does not require computing a costly quadratic projection at each iteration. Unfortunately, according to the existing analysis, Leon requires tuning an additional hyperparameter in its preconditioner and cannot achieve dimension-independent convergence guarantees for convex optimization problems beyond the bounded gradients assumption.
